title: Slovakian Pancake Recipe
description: A traditional Slovakian pancake recipe with a twist of zesty flavor. These pancakes are a perfect breakfast or brunch option.
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together flour, sugar, and zesty seasoning.
In a separate bowl, whisk together eggs and milk.
Add the wet ingredients to the dry ingredients and stir until combined.
Heat a non-stick pan or griddle over medium heat.
Add butter to the pan and pour in the batter.
Cook the pancakes for 2-3 minutes or until bubbles appear on the surface.
Flip the pancakes and cook for an additional 1-2 minutes or until golden brown.
Serve warm with your favorite toppings.
